prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one isolated painted 2D animation prop for a warm miniature village fox companion.
Primary request: a small simple handheld magnifying glass, upright, near frontal with very slight three-quarter thickness. One round muted warm brass ring, a dark walnut brown short straight handle extending vertically down from the ring. Soft hand-painted storybook shading, subtle material grain, gentle warm upper-left lighting; clean readable silhouette, no photoreal chrome.
Composition: centered on a square genuinely transparent RGBA canvas. Ring center near (0.5,0.36), outside diameter about 0.48 canvas width; handle centered x=0.5 from y=0.58 to y=0.86. Entire prop visible with margins. The lens interior must be transparent with only a very faint translucent warm-cool edge reflection, NOT an opaque white or blue disc. No shadow outside the prop.
Constraints: Only the magnifying glass. No fox, hand, paw, character, face, lettering, logo, star, glitter, UI button border, background scene, checkerboard painting or watermark. This is an animation prop, not a search-interface icon.
